gameDescriptionHtml:
The most-aesthetically charged action horror first-person platformer. You play as the last priest who goes unarmed into the devil’s abode to save the world.

“There is no God anymore –
Satan sits upon His throne.
But hope for salvation is not yet lost,
as long as one warrior of God still breathes.”

MISSION – You play as the last priest, descending into the deepest depths to destroy the very essence of evil. Your path is filled with traps, lava, and fear.
GAMEPLAY STYLE – Playing fast and aggressive or slow and steady – entirely up to you. Master your platforming skills while investigating the lore of the devil’s adobe and collecting infernal relics.
SKILLS UPGRADE – Use Bless Points to upgrade movement skills. Bless Points are awarded for completing levels and collecting full relics.
LEADERBOARD – Compete with your friends and other players to see who can complete levels the fastest.

Game Features

  • 10 levels – from mushroom caves to brutalist megastructures.
  • 2 hours for a first playthrough.
  • Horror-infused religious atmosphere.
  • Deconstructivist, brutalist, and infernal architecture.
  • Retro visuals with a modern flair.
  • Unique soundtrack – a fusion of church choirs, ritual percussion, and industrial sound.
  • Devil’s suspenseful monologues.
  • Movement skill upgrade system.
  • Leaderboard – compete with other players in level completion speed.
  • Collecting infernal relics.
  • Sliding on colossal roots.
  • Riding giant snakes.
